ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (18) has a matching target block; 3 page marker(s) preserved in place; 5 numbered section(s); attributions: Xenophon, Fénelon, Buddhist wisdom. Dhammapada, Schopenhauer, It is better to know a few rules of life than to learn many useless sciences. The rules of life will keep you from evil and direct you to good; while the knowledge of useless sciences will only lead you into the temptation of pride and keep you from clearly understanding the rules of life you need.
Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (register, omissions, glosses, attribution form).

Socrates' limits on geometry and astronomy keep Xenophon's concrete examples (land, inheritance, night watches). «Совершенствование» (sovershenstvovanie) is 'perfecting' (TERMINOLOGY); «внеличное» (vnelichnoe) is 'what is beyond the personal'; «немного лучше» (nemnogo luchshe) is 'only a little better'.
